summary: The candidate has no mathematical errors or gaps. Compactness, full dimensionality, the sufficient convexity condition, and the original mixed-volume law are established with the actual K-shaped fibers. The one-dimensional contraction has at most three preimages and proves the stated tail without changing the law. The homothetic cap inclusion, the exact d >= 10 estimates, and reflection of the integer coordinate give the claimed depth at the fixed origin. In dimensions 1 through 9, the accepted continuous centerpoint assertion applies to the absolutely continuous marginal in an enclosing cube; separation then places its selected centerpoint in RK, and reflection yields the stated stronger bound. The polynomial examples satisfy all hypotheses and realize affine center rank d. The cube normalization map and the use of the accepted predecessor assertion are explicit and valid.
